QuestInfo.name: Subani's Legacy - Transgression
QuestInfo.0: John Barricade is awaiting me in Bigger Ben! He's found something!
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as #b#t4031680#s#k. I've agreed to snag #b50#k of them so he can decipher the markings. #o9400543#s...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked, since he wants me to hunt #b100#k of them!
QuestInfo.2: I got the #b50 #t4031680#s#k that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!

0.0: Back already, huh? Well, you proved your worth, so I'll tell you a little story...

yes.0: Well, if you've heard of Dark Scrolls, you've heard about Subani. He was the powerful magician who sacrificed himself to seal away the evil demon, Naricain. The scrolls are all over the place, but that's not what we're here for. I got a tip from this funny looking guy over in Purplewood Forest, went by the name of Glimmer Man. He mentioned that Subani had a horde of items stashed away, and that the MesoGears would be a good place to look. I did some digging, thanks to the path you cleared, and found some strange markings. I don't know what they say, but I do know that there only one thing that deciphers marking like these - a #b#t4031680##k. It can decipher other languages, but the problem is, you can only use it once, and there are 50 markings. I'll need you to hunt down #b50 #t4031680#s#k so we can keep going. I know we're close to something... Try those weird-looking elephants that shoot electricity. I'm willing to bet they're hiding something in that mechanism on top of their heads!

no.0: Well, ok. You never turn down a good legend though, they always turn out to be true...

1.0: Nice work! Now, I'll need some time to study these markings.\n\n#L0##bTell me some more about your discoveries.#k#l
1.1: Heh, ok. You asked for a list, well, my bro and I have discovered King Moloson's Mines, solved the mystery of Stonegolemhenge, found Lord Pirate Kidd's gold horde, unearthed the trove of the Knights Templar of Time, the Lost El Nathian's Gold Mine, the Yeti Sphinx Chamber, and countless ancient Ossyrian galleons. Not bad for a few years! \n\n#L0##bWow! What do you think we'll find here?#k#l
1.2: I have a hunch that Subani left something here. I remember when I explored the Yeti Sphinx Chamber, I discovered an old legend that was eerily similar to that of Subani and Naricain. It also foretells that the act that created the Dark Scrolls was not their final battle. I'm not sure what we'll find, but I'm sure it pertains to that. It also mentioned another world... \n\n#L0##bAnother world? Elpam's outside, have you spoken with him?#k#l
1.3: Not yet, he smells a bit too much like old cheese... but if he really is from where he said, I might have to...

yes.0: Ok, kid, get going! Return to me soon, and I should have more information!

item.0: Looking good, kid-but I'll need #b50 #t4031680##k to read the markings.  You should also try to clear out #b100 #o9400543#s#k while you're at it. I'll be waiting!
